Sm4shCloneTool's own copies of the Smash 4 research tools it runs on (the executable research: the kind,
weapon, effect-bank, custom-move and stage-slot patches; the data-file, text, texture, ACMD and layout
readers). Adapted: comments and unused parts taken out, the defaults set to the tool's code space
(0x04B78000-0x04BB8000). acmd_info.json: the game's ACMD commands (SALT, Sammi Husky, MIT).
kind_expand_ram.json: the game's per-kind array sites (static analysis of the game's cross_f.rpx).
dspadpcm.py (1.3): the DSP-ADPCM encoder, a Python port of jackoalan's gc-dspadpcm-encode grok.c (MIT); written for
the tool (not generated by make_vendor.py, which leaves it as it is).
Credits and licences: ../THIRD_PARTY.txt.
